name: Ultiwrite
description: Investigate commercial evidence with Ultiwrite. Connect your account, read saved diligence reports and decision briefs, start an evidence upload, and check case progress.

conversation_starters.title: Connect my account
conversation_starters.text: Connect Ultiwrite and confirm which account is connected.

conversation_starters.title: Find a report
conversation_starters.text: Show my recent Ultiwrite cases and saved reports so I can choose one to review.

conversation_starters.title: Investigate evidence
conversation_starters.text: Help me submit commercial evidence that I am authorized to share with Ultiwrite.

conversation_starters.title: Read a decision brief
conversation_starters.text: Help me find an Ultiwrite report and explain its saved decision, confidence, evidence, and unresolved questions.

conversation_starters.title: Check case progress
conversation_starters.text: Help me find my Ultiwrite case and check whether its report is ready.

conversation_starters.title: Download a report
conversation_starters.text: Help me find a saved Ultiwrite report and open its available downloads.
